#The value for Case Number is the D365 case number combined with a prepended 6-digit Cityworks SR number when the two systems interface
#When the two systems fail to interface, the prepended 6-digit Cityworks SR number is not combined
#Splitting the Case Number column into two new columns - SR_Num and Case_Num - to isolate the prepended 6-digit Cityworks SR number
df2 = pd.read_csv('My_Projects/Urban_Forestry/D365/311_SRs_2020.csv')
df2[['SR_Num', 'Case_Num']] = df2['Case Number'].str.split('-',expand=True)
df2
